title: Perfume dupe prices vs the originals, 2026 (10ML research)
citation: 10ML (2026). Perfume dupe prices vs the originals, 2026 (10ML research). https://10ml.com/data/dupe-price-gap-2026-10.json. CC BY 4.0. Accessed 2026-10-22.
method: One row per pair of an original perfume and a dupe made by another house. The original’s price is one EU price for one bottle size, from the house’s own EU store where it has one, else an EU retailer; the dupe’s price is one EU shop’s price for one bottle size, each read on its own checked date. Price per ml is price ÷ size. Saving per ml is 1 − (dupe price per ml ÷ original price per ml). Where one of 10ML’s guides lists the dupe, that guide’s table price, size, shop and date are used, so the two pages never disagree; otherwise the research file’s. EUR prices only: pairs priced in USD, GBP or AUD are left out, never converted. The headline saving is the median over originals of each original’s median saving. Rows sorted alphabetically by house, perfume and size: the original’s, then the dupe’s.

coverage.geography: EU stores and shops (the original houses’ own EU stores or EU retailers; EU shops for the dupes)

caveats: The originals are a curated selection of popular designer and niche perfumes that have well-known dupes, not the whole market.
One price per perfume: the size and shop vary from row to row, and prices change; each row carries its own check date.
A price comparison only: whether a dupe smells like its original is a matter of opinion and is covered in 10ML’s guides to each original’s dupes.
